approaches_tried.approach: Case 3 fixture without a decoy document
approaches_tried.reason: literature-search.sh's own zero-result unfiltered-retry fallback masked the regression: under the reverted (pre-Phase-2) get_project_doc_ids, the project-filtered query legitimately returned zero rows, which triggered the script's existing fallback-retry-without-filter, which then found case3_fts_id anyway via the unfiltered search -- passing the test even with the bridge fix reverted. Added a decoy document (case3_decoy_doc, .id == its own FTS doc_id, matching the same query term) so the filtered query returns a nonzero result set under BOTH pre-fix and post-fix code, preventing the fallback from ever triggering and making the test genuinely discriminating.
